judge_prompt: Exact authors' five-dimensional rubric, extracted from score_answer AST.
repeat_semantics: Three independent executions at temperature zero; no undocumented seed parameter is invented.
subset_selection: Original predeclared seed-5660 subset retained; development questions 43,26,17 excluded. Historical DeepSeek results exist for this subset.
order: Three concurrent question blocks; within each block three repetitions with cyclic condition order (question ordinal + repetition) mod 3.
isolation: Every terminal command runs in an unprivileged bubblewrap namespace. Pinned clean Streamlink archive is read-only at /workspace. Host project answers, references, credentials and network are outside the namespace.
primary_population: All eight questions and all three repetitions, 24 cells per condition. Report answer availability separately. Missing answers receive zero only in an explicitly labelled failure-aware aggregate.
retry_policy: Preserve first attempt. One additional attempt for missing answer, process failure, or explicit pruning-service failure. Judge score never triggers an agent retry. Report first-attempt and recovered results separately.
judge_retry_policy: Up to three attempts only on transport/schema failure, retaining raw responses.
metrics: pruning activation and retained source tokens
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over eight question clusters, retaining all repetitions together; 10000 resamples with seed 5660. Descriptive interval, limited by eight-question coverage.
paper_comparison: Table 2 Streamlink GLM-4.6 baseline score 8.56, 18.2 rounds, 318200 tokens; pruner 8.56, 25.0, 145100. Paper population, serving route, SDK version and unpublished judge deployment prevent exact numerical equivalence.
modification: Lossless task-scoped observation storage and explicit bounded line-range recovery; same shared runtime and pruning settings.
mechanism_followup: Controlled fixed-context evidence recovery study is reported separately from the autonomous benchmark. Freeze its case selection and scoring before its model calls.
